data.one_liner: A search page widget built for minimal work and good performance.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use search page widgets and app bars that filter static lists, reactive GetX lists, or asynchronous API data sources. It handles keyboard navigation, query debouncing, and highlights selected items.
use_when: You need a quick search page or search bar with minimal boilerplate in a Flutter app.
You are using GetX for state management and want reactive search lists.
You need to filter lists locally or query them asynchronously from an API.
avoid_when: You do not use or want GetX dependencies in your application.
You require a completely custom search UI that does not fit the provided page layouts.
strengths: Built-in support for static lists, GetX reactive lists, and asynchronous API calls.
Keyboard navigation support for web and desktop (Arrow keys, Enter, Esc).
Handles filtering, debouncing, and screen width responsiveness out of the box.
weaknesses: Relies on specific widget structures provided by the package.
